Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical handbook page from the selected range; nothing relies on outside knowledge.
The fatality percentages and the unbelted death count are dated statistics for a fixed reporting period; they are kept as context and flagged dynamic, not taught as rules [A01].
The handbook gives the under-six and under-fifty-seven-inch restraint rule with the statute number NRS 484B.157; the rule is restated without copying the statute text [A01].
The age chart graphic on the second page shows seat types against ages but its bars are not legible in extracted text, so no age range was read from the chart [A02].
The airbag speed figure is the handbook's own illustrative number and is cited only to its page.
